where: Dread Mob rule · Try Dat Button!

mod.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when selected to attack (optional: one D6 or two D6)
mod.note: 1–2 +1 A · 3–4 +2 S · 5–6 +1 AP (two D6: keep re-rolling duplicate results; one hazard roll when the unit has attacked)

dice.note: two D6, one result: “keep re-rolling duplicate results” can mean the same row of the table (two D6 always give two results) or the same die value (a 1 and a 2 give one result, and the hazard roll is still made)

source.text:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly **ORKS WALKER** unit (excluding **TITANIC** units) is **selected to attack**, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit’s attacks have the relevant rule(s):
If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one **hazard roll**.
1–2: +1 **A**
3–4: +2 **S**
5–6: +1 **AP**
